stemMd: Which new discovery would most directly reduce uncertainty about unphotographed rows?

options.label: A
options.textMd: A modern poster advertising unrelated performances

options.label: B
options.textMd: Another copy of the same unbuilt proposal

options.label: C
options.textMd: A reliable opening-day survey recording their installed positions

options.label: D
options.textMd: A list of theatre ticket prices alone

options.label: E
options.textMd: A statement that old buildings are interesting

explanationMd: A reliable survey of installed positions at opening would address the missing as-built information directly. Its relevance lies in documenting the uncertain feature at the relevant time, rather than merely adding another historical document.

distractorRationale.b: Repeating the proposal would not resolve the as-built question.
distractorRationale.a: It does not document the original rows.
distractorRationale.d: Prices do not specify seat positions.
distractorRationale.e: This adds no evidence about the arrangement.
